∧.name: bit and
∧.plain: a ∧ b is bitwise AND on nonnegative integers.

∨.name: bit or
∨.plain: a ∨ b is bitwise OR on nonnegative integers.

⊻.name: bit xor
⊻.plain: a ⊻ b is bitwise XOR on nonnegative integers.

⇐.name: shift left
⇐.plain: a ⇐ b shifts nonnegative a left by b bits; counts above 31 give NaN.

⇒.name: shift right
⇒.plain: a ⇒ b shifts nonnegative a right by b bits.

♯.name: bit count
♯.plain: a ♯ counts the one bits of nonnegative a; negative inputs give NaN.
